mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 5 Series 520i engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW 5 Series 520i engine replacement typically costs £1,500-£3,600 supply-only for rebuilt units, or £2,800-£5,500 fitted by a specialist. Prices vary by engine code and generation. Used N46B20 engines: £800-£1,400 supply-only. Used N20B20 engines: £1,200-£1,900 supply-only. Reconditioned B48B20 units: £2,200-£3,200 supply-only. Rebuilt N20B20 units: £2,200-£3,400 supply-only. Professional fitting adds £800-£1,500 depending on workshop location.

mainEntity.name: Which engine does the BMW 5 Series 520i have - N46, N20 or B48?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 520i badge spans three engine families depending on the generation: E60 520i (2003-2010): N46B20, 150-170hp, naturally aspirated. F10 520i (2010-2016): N20B20, 184hp, turbocharged. G30 520i (2017-present): B48B20, 184hp, turbocharged, closed-deck block. G60 520i (2023-present): B48B20, 208hp, 48V mild hybrid.

mainEntity.name: Is the BMW 5 Series 520i N20 engine reliable? I've heard about timing chain problems.

acceptedAnswer.text: The N20B20 is a capable engine, but early units (pre-2015) are prone to timing chain guide degradation between 40,000-70,000 miles. The problem is caused by plastic guides that become brittle under heat cycling. Timing chain rattle on cold start is the first warning sign. Preventative chain replacement costs £1,400-£1,900 at a specialist. Post-2015 N20 units received revised guide materials. B48 engines in G30 models have largely resolved timing chain concerns.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of cooling system failure on a BMW 5 Series 520i B48?

acceptedAnswer.text: The B48 engine's most common cooling system issues include coolant level drops without visible external leaks, coolant vent line cracking (between cylinder head and expansion tank), oil filter housing cracking causing coolant loss, warning lights on the dashboard, and overheating if coolant loss is ignored.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine on a high-mileage BMW 5 Series 520i?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an F10 520i worth £4,000-£8,000, a rebuilt N20 at £2,200-£3,400 can make financial sense if the body, gearbox, and interior are in good condition. For G30 examples, replacement is generally viable given higher retained values. Compare replacement cost against vehicle value - replacement is viable up to 70% of car's value. F10 520i values have stabilised; a good example justifies investment. B48 engines in G30 command higher value - replacement more easily justified. Always factor 12-month warranty into replacement decision.

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my N20 engine with a B48 in my BMW 5 Series 520i?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both are 2.0-litre turbo petrol engines, swapping an N20 for a B48 is not straightforward and is rarely cost-effective: different engine mounts, wiring harness, and ECU calibration. B48 requires different cooling system components. DME coding and immobiliser adaptation required. Specialist verification essential before ordering.

commonProblems.h2: BMW 5 Series 520i - What It Costs to Fix, and When Replacement Makes Sense
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 5 Series 520i has evolved from the naturally aspirated N46 to the turbocharged N20 and the modern B48, each with its own well-documented wear patterns. The N20 engine family drives the highest volume of replacement enquiries due to early timing chain guide degradation, while the B48 suffers from cooling system weaknesses. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components designed to address these original failure points - plus a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Guide Failure - Why the F10 520i N20 Engine Rattles on Start-Up
problems.rootCause: The N20's plastic timing chain guides degrade under heat cycling, leading to chain slack, rattling on cold start, and eventual chain slip or snap. If ignored, the chain can skip teeth, allowing pistons to contact valves - catastrophic engine failure requiring full replacement.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace timing chain, guides, tensioner, oil pump sprocket
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early before chain jumps; 60,000+ mile lifespan

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt N20B20 with reinforced chain guides, upgraded tensioner, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if chain has snapped causing valve/piston damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW 5 Series 520i is worth £4,000-£18,000 depending on generation, mileage, and condition (`[THIRD-PARTY]` - Auto Trader market observation). For an F10 520i worth £4,000-£8,000, a rebuilt engine at £2,200-£3,400 can represent 40-70% of the vehicle's value - evaluate body, gearbox, and interior condition carefully before committing. For G30 examples worth £10,000+, replacement is generally viable.
problems.recommendation: If your F10 520i develops a cold-start rattle that disappears as the engine warms, act immediately - preventative chain replacement saves thousands. Once the chain snaps, the engine is beyond economic repair. Frequent oil changes (every 8,000-10,000 miles) are critical for N20 longevity.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt N20B20 engine prices for your BMW 5 Series 520i

problems.h4: Coolant System Failure - Why the G30 520i B48 Engine Loses Coolant
problems.rootCause: The B48's plastic coolant vent line between the cylinder head and expansion tank can crack, causing rapid coolant loss. The oil filter housing can also crack, leaking coolant into the engine bay.

repairOptions.tier: Coolant Vent Line & Expansion Tank Replacement
repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace coolant vent line, expansion tank, coolant flush
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early; 40,000+ mile lifespan

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace oil filter housing with updated unit, new gaskets, coolant flush
Supply & fit rebuilt B48 with upgraded cooling components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if overheating caused head gasket or cylinder head damage

problems.recommendation: The B48 is generally reliable, but cooling system issues are its Achilles' heel. Check coolant levels monthly and address any drops immediately. A £300-£500 specialist vent line replacement is cheap insurance against a warped cylinder head. On any G30 520i approaching 60,000 miles without documented cooling system work, proactive inspection is strongly advised.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW 5 Series 520i B48 cooling system repair costs

problems.h4: Oil Leaks - Why the BMW 5 Series 520i Loses Oil
problems.rootCause: The valve cover gasket and oil filter housing gasket become brittle with age and heat cycling, allowing oil to seep onto the engine or exhaust components.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace valve cover gasket and/or oil filter housing gasket
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early; 50,000+ mile lifespan

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt engine with new gaskets, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if oil starvation caused bearing damage

problems.recommendation: Oil leaks on the 520i's four-cylinder engines are common but rarely catastrophic if addressed promptly. Check for oil around the valve cover and oil filter housing regularly. A £300-£550 specialist gasket replacement is cheap insurance against a more serious oil starvation issue.
